_about: Public-domain John Leng (1665-1727), Bishop of Norwich, for the Word Hoard: Natural Obligations to Believe the Principles of Religion and Divine Revelation (his Boyle Lectures of 1717-18) and his sermons of 1699 to 1727. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-24 by lane A, round 136 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

leng-st-katherines-1704: A sermon preached at the consecration of the chappel of St. Katherine's-Hall, in the University of Cambridge, September 1. 1704. By John Leng ... To which is added the form of consecration used by the Lord Bishop of Ely.  1704 (catalogued 1704)
leng-st-pauls-1713: A sermon preach'd at the cathedral-church of St. Paul.  1713 (catalogued 1713)
leng-knowledge-of-god: Knowledge of the nature and providence of God, an inducement to believe and trust in Him. A sermon preach'd at Tunbridge-Wells in Kent, on Sunday Sept. 4th, 1715, ... By John Leng, ...  1715 (catalogued 1715)
leng-praying-for-kings: The duty of praying for kings, and for all in authority. A sermon preach'd in the parish-church of Bedington in Surrey, November 6. 1715. By John Leng, ...  1715 (catalogued 1715)
leng-advantages-government: The advantages of government, and the duty of preserving it. A sermon preach'd at the assizes held at Kingston upon Thames, March 22. 1715. ... By J. Leng, ...  1716 (catalogued 1716)
leng-gods-government: God's government of the world, matter of great joy. A sermon preach'd at Tunbridge-Wells, on Wednesday, August 1st, 1716....By John Leng,...  1716 (catalogued 1716)
leng-reformation-manners: A sermon preached to the Societies for reformation of manners at St. Mary-le-Bow; on Monday, December the 29th MDCCXVIII. By John Leng, ...  1719 (catalogued 1719)
leng-natural-obligations: Natural obligations to believe the principles of religion, and divine revelation : in xvi sermons, preached in the Church of St. Mary le Bow, London, in the years 1717 and 1718 ; at the lecture founded by the honourable Robert Boyle, Esq (London : Printed by W.B. for Robert Knaplock, 1719)
leng-lords-1726: A sermon preach'd before the Lords ... at the Collegiate-church of St. Peter, Westminster, on Monday, January the 31st 1725. ... By ... John Lord Bishop of Norwich.  1726 (catalogued 1726)
leng-spg-1727: A sermon preached before the incorporated Society for the propagation of the Gospel in Foreign Parts.  1727 (catalogued 1727)
